caption: Two upright mannequins with foil-wrapped faces, wide-brimmed hats and white lab coats stand side by side on a circular platform, framed by silver truss towers against a clear blue sky, dry desert hills and a white fabric barrier. A tall red-and-grey panel with faint scale numbers sits behind them. The view slowly enlarges as the truss legs drift toward the frame edges and the panel grows more visible. A bright yellow-orange flash flares at the right figure's shoulder while a white burst opens at the left figure's head. A dense white cloud then erupts and expands, engulfing both forms. The lab coats shred, and torn white fabric strips are thrown outward, a long sleeve piece flying to the right. The hats are pushed upward, perched atop the billowing cloud before becoming partly obscured. The cloud keeps churning and spreading, filling most of the frame while the bodies vanish behind it. The slow enlargement continues through the burst, so the white mass occupies more of the view.
